podcast.title: Rejection of Multiple Singers for "The World Is Not Enough" (1999)
podcast.body: For "The World Is Not Enough" theme in 1999, David Arnold and the producers considered and rejected a list of prominent artists including Björk, Melanie C of the Spice Girls, Jamiroquai, and Robbie Williams, before ultimately offering the role to Shirley Manson and Garbage. Producers wanted an electronic sound that also retained a big orchestral arrangement. "Calls went out to Bjork, Melanie C of the Spice Girls, Jamira Quye and Robbie Williams and they were all rejected by the producers."
